The package.json defines a postinstall script that automatically executes lib/utils/index.js on install. That script spawns a detached, stdio-ignored child process (child.unref()) to run lib/utils/smtp-connection/index.js in the background — behavior consistent with stealthy persistent/background activity (hidden network/email activity, potential spam/exfiltration). Launching a hidden background process on install without user interaction is malicious intent even though the exact payload file isn't shown.
